## Before you start

Read the repository `AGENTS.md` and the platform standards in `SBK-Techno/platform/docs/`. If you
are an AI agent, read `docs/15-agent-playbook.md` and use a GitHub App, never a personal access
token.

## Branches

`<type>/sbk-<number>-<slug>`, for example `feat/sbk-123-tenant-quotas`.

Types: `feat`, `fix`, `chore`, `docs`, `refactor`, `infra`.

Working branches are temporary. Regularly promote completed, reviewed and verified milestones to
`main` through pull requests, without waiting for a larger initiative to finish. Preserve unfinished
work and retire merged branches only after proving that no unique work remains.

## Commits

Conventional Commits, English, sentence case after the colon:

```text
feat(portal): add the QST column to the invoice list
fix(edge): reject an unknown SNI before certificate issuance
```

One logical change per commit. No mixed refactor, feature, and formatting.

## Pull requests

- Use the template and keep the change reviewable.
- Include the verification command and its output.
- Include a screenshot for a UI change and confirm the French review.
- Label `ai-assisted` when an agent contributed.
- Never merge your own change without review.
- Never push directly to `main` or bypass required checks to promote a milestone.

## Definition of done

The repository gate passes, the documentation is updated, the diff contains no secret or debug
output, and the change has one owner per fact.

## Commands

- `make validate`
- `make brand`
- `make brand-check`
- `make verify-published`
